title: Turn a count certificate into a valid upper experiment-error bound
statement: Stop BEFORE paid readB+1 and emit an abort/fallback. Ideal and truncated cq experiments share a common positive nonaborting part, so half trace distance/TV<=Pr[N_T>B]<=Pr[Bin(T,q*)>B] without a square root.

requires: The same private exact module/controller experiment, admissible abort continuation and paid callback stopped beforeB+1.
provides: Stop BEFORE paid readB+1 and emit an abort/fallback. Ideal and truncated cq experiments share a common positive nonaborting part, so half trace distance/TV<=Pr[N_T>B]<=Pr[Bin(T,q*)>B] without a square root.
assumptions: Does not optimize approximate error, expose internal costs safely or acquire a physical channel.
costs: Charge the actually supplied physical source, preparation/reset, calibration, record/archive/randomness and full-cycle operations. Algebraic scalar calls or source software timings are not physical bits, measured throughput or wall-plug work. Equally informed ordinary methods may use the same inputs and operations; no complete-resource advantage established.
contract.units: All model quantities retain their supplied units: dimensionless channel probabilities/cycle log rate ratios/model fields; photon counts, seconds/rates, pressure and mechanical work require actual source calibration. Distinct clocks, records, dose, energy and source-work conventions are not interchanged.
contract.obstruction: Does not optimize approximate error, expose internal costs safely or acquire a physical channel. No newly acquired physical source law, detector/channel calibration, uniform drive bus, loaded composed device, chemistry, practical advantage or historical priority. Producer scripts/large saved checks are preserved as source evidence, not rerun. Chemistry full numerical proof/program archives remain UNACQUIRED/DEFERRED. Mission NOT_ACHIEVED.

body: This is an upper error guarantee; a useful fallback or globally approximate method may do better. Conditioning on no abort can bias the record. Rational tail output hasO(T logb) bits forq=a/b, not polynomial-in-logT encoding. Exact fair-bit sampling has finite expected cost, not bounded worst-case time.
